WL Plant Data
Column title Definition Description
plt Unique Identifier Plant Individual
year Year sampled 2007 or 2008
av.dam Average proportion flowerhead area damaged over all flowerheads produced per plant Average is of four quarters of the receptacle scored for damage and converted to a proportion. See full explanation in associated journal article.
no.flw Number of flowerheads Total number of buds that reached anthesis (flowered)
n.fl.sds Number of flowerheads with successful seed set Only includes flowerheads from which seeds were counted
plt.gsd "Number of ""good"" seed produced per plant" Sum of all seeds that appeared fully developed and with minimal to no insect feeding damage produced from all flowerheads on a plant
dam Apical Damage Treatment "nd: apical flowerhead undamage, protected by insecticide; d: apical flowerhead damaged, received water treatment (see full explaination in associated journal article)"
ins Insecticide Treatment i: flowerheads protected with insecticide (reduced herbivore pressure); ni: flowerheads received water treatment (ambient herbivore pressure)
trt Treatment "Combined 2x2 treatment: ndi, ndni = no apical damage under reduced and ambient herbivore pressure; di, dni = apical damage under reduced and ambient herbivore pressure"
ap.hd "Number of ""good"" seeds produced by the apical flowerhead" Seeds that appeared fully developed and with minimal to no insect feeding
o.hds "Summed total number of ""good"" seed produced by all non-apical flowerheads " Seeds that appeared fully developed and with minimal to no insect feeding
n.hds Total number of flower buds per plant All buds greater than or equal to 2-mm in diameter
r.diam Basal rosette diameter Calculated as average of two perpendicular measurements
n.br Number of branches Branches from the main stem greater than 1 cm length
plt.ht Plant height "in cm, to the base of the highest flowerhead"
pnt.flw Proportion of non-apical flower buds that flowered Calculated as: no.flw/n.hds
pnt.ohds Proportion of seed production from non-apical flower heads Calculated as: o.hds/plt.gsd
sds.flhd "Average number of ""good"" seeds produced per total flowerheads" Calculated as: o.hds/no.flw
sd.fh.sd "Average number of ""good"" seeds produced per seed-producing flowerhead" Calculated as: o.hds/n.fl.sds
WL Flowerhead Data
Column title Definition Description
plt Unique Identifier Plant Individual
year Year sampled 2007 or 2008
dam Apical Damage Treatment "nd: apical flowerhead undamage, protected by insecticide; d: apical flowerhead damaged, received water treatment (see full explaination in associated journal article)"
ins Insecticide Treatment i: flowerheads protected with insecticide (reduced herbivore pressure); ni: flowerheads received water treatment (ambient herbivore pressure)
hd Head number "Flowerhead position on plant. Apical head is ""100""; successive '00 heads are branch terminal flowerheads, branches between the terminals and stem are '0 (e.g., 310)"
av.dam Average proportion flowerhead area damaged Average is of four quarters of the receptacle scored for damage and converted to a proportion. See full explanation in associated journal article
hd.gsd "Number of ""good"" seed produced by that flowerhead" seeds that appeared fully developed and with minimal to no insect feeding
